## Numerical illustrations {#what-to-try}

- **All direction probabilities.** The Blues legend shows “Pr(row truly higher)” for every ordered pair.
- **Above the threshold.** At λ = .25 (τ = .200), the pairwise rule states 1,575 pairs above .800.
- **Add the card blocks.** Hatching marks 575 confident pairs withheld inside grades; purple outlines mark 324 stated pairs with error above τ.
- **λ .50 blocks.** The cut admits 2,994 pairs; the card withholds 49 and states 545 with error above τ.
- **Gender blocks.** Switches to the signed male-name contact advantage.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
Archived cards follow KRW's code (Figures 5A, 7, 10A and 14) under released postrank probabilities.
